Name: Bird Feeder Scarecrow Replacement (XNB Mod Update for 1.11)
Author: joyous1ariella
Description:
This is a 1.11 compatibility update of peudepeu's mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/484/?]Scarecrow Replacement.[/url] All creds go to them.

I made the bird feeder replace [i]only the default scarecrow, [/i]since that was requested.

***[i]This mod is not compatible with anything that alters the Craftables.xnb file!***[/i]

Enjoy!
-Ariella
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley game folder and go to the Content-->TileSheets folder (mine is at C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets)
[*]MAKE A COPY OF Craftables.xnb FOR BACKUP!
[*]Extract the .rar to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program and overwrite the file.
[/list]
